newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK/GREECE TO DRAIN 14-DAY FUNDS AT 11.90PCT.
newsitem.headline: BANK/GREECE TO DRAIN 14-DAY FUNDS AT 11.90PCT.

text.p: Greece's central bank will hold a depo tender to drain 14-day funds at 11.90 percent on Wednesday, it said in a statement.

"The Bank of Greece announces that on Wednesday 4 June 1997 it will accept deposits from banks through a fixed rate tender," it said. "Total amount to be set by the central bank after the submission of bids at 11.90 percent."
Payment date is June 4 and maturity value date is June 18, it said.
Bids should be submitted by fax between 1130 local (0830 GMT) and 1230 (0930 GMT).
